title: Keratitis, Nonulcerative

content_blocks.text: An inflammatory disorder of the cornea that does not retain fluorescein stain.
A pathologic response resulting in reduced corneal clarity secondary to edema, inflammatory cell infiltration, vascularization, pigmentation, lipid or calcium deposition, or scarring.
No proven genetic basis in dogs or cats.

Periodic ocular examination recommended to evaluate efficacy of treatment; examine at 1to 2-week intervals, gradually lengthening the interval with remission or resolution of clinical signs; taper medications based on resolution of clinical signs; complete resolution of pigmentation may not occur.
